prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Atlanta for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every car-accident case — the right lawyer depends on the facts of your crash, the severity of injuries, your goals, and your budget. I can, however, help you find the best lawyer for your situation. To start, a few practical steps and signs of a strong Atlanta car-accident attorney:

What to look for
- Relevant experience: lots of Georgia car-accident cases and trial experience (not just fender-benders or insurance defense).
- Track record: significant settlements or jury verdicts for cases like yours (fractures, spinal injuries, wrongful death, catastrophic loss).
- Reputation and peer recognition: AV Preeminent (Martindale-Hubbell), Super Lawyers, Million Dollar Advocates, state/local plaintiff trial lawyer associations.
- Communication and availability: clear explanation of process, responsive, will meet or visit you if needed.
- Fee structure: contingency fee (typical for PI), clear disclosure of costs and who pays out-of-pocket expenses.
- Local court knowledge: familiarity with Atlanta and Fulton/DeKalb/Georgia courts, local judges and insurance adjusters.
- No disciplinary history: check the Georgia Bar for standing and complaints.

Questions to ask when you interview a lawyer
- How many car-accident cases have you handled? How many went to trial?
- Have you handled cases like mine (injury type, severity, fault issues)?
- What was a recent outcome for a similar case?
- Who will handle my case day-to-day (partner, associate, paralegal)?
- How do you charge? What percentage and what expenses would be deducted?
- How long do you expect this case to take?
- Can you provide client references or reviews?

Where to search & verify
- Super Lawyers, Avvo, Martindale-Hubbell
- Georgia Trial Lawyers Association (GTLA)
- Million Dollar Advocates / National Trial Lawyers lists
- Google Reviews and local Facebook groups
- Georgia Office of Bar Admissions / State Bar of Georgia for disciplinary records

If you want, I can:
- Give a short list of well-reviewed Atlanta car-accident attorneys/firms (I’ll include contact info and why they’re recommended) — tell me your zip code or county and a brief description of the injury and issues (neck/back, broken bones, wrongful death, uninsured driver, etc.).
- Or prepare a shortlist of interview questions and a comparison checklist you can use when you call 4–6 firms.

Which would you prefer? If you want names, tell me your location and a few details about your accident.
